faq_heading: Homes near Cougar Canyon Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Cougar Canyon Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Cougar Canyon Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Cougar Canyon Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Cougar Canyon Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 115 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,300,000, townhomes $722,500, condos $525,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Cougar Canyon Elementary?
faq.a: For the 115 homes that sold within 1 km of Cougar Canyon Elementary, the median time on the market was 34 days and the median sale was 97.1% of list; 8% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Cougar Canyon Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Seaquam Secondary (0.2 km west), Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.8 km west) and Heath Elementary (0.9 km north-west).

Cougar Canyon Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 11664 Lyon Rd. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Cougar Canyon Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Cougar Canyon Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Cougar Canyon Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Cougar Canyon Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 115 homes sold within 1 km of Cougar Canyon Elementary: 60 houses, 35 townhomes and 19 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,300,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Cougar Canyon Elementary

24 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Cougar Canyon Elementary in a straight line (17 elementary, 7 secondary; 1 independent). The closest is Seaquam Secondary, 0.2 km away, and the farthest on this list is North Delta Secondary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Sunshine Hills Elementary (0.8 km west), Heath Elementary (0.9 km north-west), Cougar Creek Elementary (1.3 km east), Pinewood Elementary (1.3 km south), Beaver Creek Elementary (1.5 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Sunshine Hills Elementary, 0.8 km west of Cougar Canyon Elementary.
